lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 adds a verdict-shape guard to makeReadReviewReport: now returns null when the parsed JSON is an array, or when the `verdict` field is not a string. Previously a wrong-shape object (e.g. { notAVerdict: true }) would be returned as-is, causing makeReviewDispatch to call /^FIXES_PENDING:(\d+)$/.exec(undefined) and derive FIXES_PENDING:0, overriding a valid <review>CLEAN</review> pane tag. Added 6 regression tests (5 unit tests for the reader directly + 1 end-to-end dispatch regression) in test/supervisor/review.test.ts. 1286 tests pass / 0 fail. Check prd.json for next story (if any).
